## Import Libraries
```{r Libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

## Import Data
```{r import data}
# whole time series
dfWhole <- read_csv("Data/CleanData/CleanData_YSI/03_DescriptiveStatistics/WholeSeriesDescriptiveStats.csv")

# yearly
dfYear <- read_csv("Data/CleanData/CleanData_YSI/03_DescriptiveStatistics/YearlyDescriptiveStats.csv")

# monthly
dfMonth <- read_csv("Data/CleanData/CleanData_YSI/03_DescriptiveStatistics/MonthlyDescriptiveStats.csv")

# daily
dfDay <- read_csv("Data/CleanData/CleanData_YSI/03_DescriptiveStatistics/DailyDescriptiveStats.csv")
```

## Data Formatting
```{r data formatting}
dfYearPivot <- dfYear %>%
  mutate(std_lower = mean - std,
         std_upper = mean + std,
         .after = std)


  pivot_longer(cols = mean:max,
               names_to = "stat",
               values_to = "stat_value")

```


# Basic Plots
```{r basic plots}
# whole time series #not sure if want to plot this yet bc it's just one value instead of multiple values spanning  time intervals

# yearly
pHPlot_year <- dfYearPivot %>%
  filter(variable == "pH") 

%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, 
             y = mean)) +
  geom_line(color = "red") +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = length(unique(dfYear$year)))+
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        panel.background = element_blank(), 
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(0.25, 0.45, 0.25, 0.25, "inch"))+
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))+
  labs(title = "B2O pH Statistics from 2011-2023")+
  xlab("Date")+
  ylab("pH")
# Save plot
# ggsave(filename = "TempFPlot-PostQC.pdf", plot = TempFPlot_PostQC, 
#        path = "Figures/Figures_YSI/02-PostQCPlots")
pHPlot_year

# monthly

# daily

```
